standard-dialogue.text: If the player has a Jagex Account and a bank PIN:

steps.npc: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has a Jagex Account, but does not have a bank PIN:

steps.npc: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Bank PIN, so you fail my checks! Talk to a banker to set a PIN before we meet again.

steps.text: To set a Bank PIN, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player does not have a Jagex Account:

steps.npc: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, so you fail my checks! You should upgrade before we meet again.

steps.text: To upgrade your account, visit the RuneScape Website and log in to update your Account settings.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player does not have a Jagex Account or a bank PIN:

steps.npc: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, nor a Bank PIN, so so you fail my checks! Please upgrade before we meet again.

steps.text: To upgrade your account, visit the RuneScape Website and log in to update your Account settings.
To set a Bank PIN, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player does not have a Jagex Account, but has a bank PIN (only on worlds where the Jagex Account requirement is waived):

steps.npc: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.

standard-dialogue-other-player-s-event.npc: I came to check [player name], not you.

overhead-dialogue.text: Upon spawning in for the player:
While waiting for a response by the player:

steps.npc: Please let me check you, [player name]!
I have come to check you, [player name]...

overhead-dialogue.text: If the player does not respond in time:

steps.npc: Ahahahaha, ONE more person ignored me...
